description: Tests the ability of a user to authenticate using the GitHub OAuth option from the login page.
steps: Navigate to the login page at https://dev.roost.ai/login.
Verify the presence of the GitHub OAuth login option.
Click on the GitHub OAuth login link.
Wait for the GitHub login page to load.
Enter valid GitHub account credentials (username and password).
Authorize the application on the GitHub page.
Verify that the user is redirected back to https://dev.roost.ai/login.
Verify the presence of a session token indicating successful login.
Confirm that the user is redirected to the primary application dashboard at https://dev.roost.ai.
expected_results: User should be redirected to the GitHub login page.
User should successfully authorize the application.
User should be redirected back to the application dashboard.
A session token should be generated.
edge_cases: Invalid GitHub credentials result in an error message.
GitHub authorization is denied by the user.
GitHub OAuth API returns an unexpected response.
Network failure during redirection interrupts the login process.
Session token is not generated upon successful authorization.
data_requirements: Access to the GitHub OAuth API.
Valid client ID and redirect URI for integration.
User account in Roost platform linked to GitHub.
dependencies: Valid client ID is registered with GitHub.
User has an existing GitHub account.
Roost platform supports GitHub OAuth integration.
api_interactions: Roost backend API for session token generation.
Redirection mechanism handling between GitHub and Roost.
performance_metrics: Time taken to load the GitHub OAuth login page.
Time taken for redirection back to Roost after login.
accessibility_requirements: GitHub login page must be accessible for screen readers.
Ensure the GitHub OAuth login link has appropriate ARIA labels.
Verify keyboard navigation for the login link.
